title: Noyra: A Non-Command Artificial Subject for Real-World Environments
description: Experimental research source preview, revision preview-2026.09.07-r1. Persistent identity, internally generated goals, memory and non-command human interaction with bounded real-world interfaces. Real signer, automatic payments, file capabilities and real funds remain disabled in the preview configuration. This is not a production-stable release or proof of subjective consciousness or global priority.
